desc: Derive the exact reachability characterization for transforming the initial piece configuration \(A\) into an occupancy pattern \(B\).
Prove a formula or algorithm for the minimum number of operations, including how optimal pivot positions can be reconstructed or counted.
Investigate invariants and edge cases: piece count, order preservation, merging, boundary squares, and patterns with isolated zero/one runs.
Develop an \(O(N)\) implementation strategy and verify it on the public samples and relevant edge cases.
Specify the final Python input/output implementation and complexity analysis.
